data.title: My First React Component
data.description: Create a React component named `Welcome` with a heading 'Welcome to React' and a paragraph 'This is my first React application.' The `App` component must render `Welcome`.

requirements.description: Component name must be Welcome.
Must render an h1 with text 'Welcome to React'.
Must render a paragraph with text 'This is my first React application.'
App component must render Welcome.

data.title: JSX Expressions with Variables
data.description: Create variables `name` and `age`. Display: the name, 'Age: {age}', and 'Age Next Year: {age + 1}'. Requirements: use JSX expressions and use variables inside JSX.

Must use JSX expressions {} to embed variables.

data.title: Interactive Profile Card
data.description: Create a profile card displaying 'Frontend Developer' / 'Learning React JSX Attributes'. Requirements: 1) const cardClass = "profile-card" used as className. 2) A 'Show Message' button that alerts 'Hello React!' on click, initially enabled. 3) A disabled 'Coming Soon' button. 4) Inline style object on the heading: color darkblue, fontSize 32px, backgroundColor lightblue.

requirements.description: Must use cardClass variable as className.
Show Message button must call alert('Hello React!') on click.
Coming Soon button must be disabled.
Heading must use a JS style object via inline style.

data.title: Styling with JS Style Objects
data.description: Create a profile card displaying 'Alex Johnson' / 'Frontend Developer' / 'Learning React Styling'. Requirements: 1) cardStyle object: lightblue background, 20px padding, 10px border radius, center align. 2) headingStyle object: darkblue color, 32px font size. 3) Inline style directly on the paragraph 'Learning React Styling': green color, bold font weight using style={{ ... }}. 4) Use camelCase CSS properties (backgroundColor, fontSize, textAlign, fontWeight).

requirements.description: Must define cardStyle and headingStyle objects with camelCase properties.
Must apply inline style={{ color: 'green', fontWeight: 'bold' }} directly on the paragraph.

data.title: React CSS Modules
data.description: Create a `Button` component that uses a CSS Module for styling. Import the styles from `Button.module.css` (assume the file exists). Apply the `mybutton` class from the imported styles object to a `<button>` element with the text 'Click Me'. UI requirements for Pixel-perfect: The screen background is `#f0f2f5`. The button must have a `#4CAF50` background color, `#ffffff` text color, padding will be `15px 32px`, font size is `16px`, the `border-radius` is `8px`, no border, and a `cursor: pointer`. Ensure the button is centered on the screen.

code_test.css: body { margin: 0; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; height: 100vh; background-color: #f0f2f5; font-family: sans-serif; } .mybutton { background-color: #4CAF50; color: #ffffff; padding: 15px 32px; font-size: 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; }

requirements.description: Component name must be Button.
Must import styles from Button.module.css.
Must use the imported styles object (e.g., styles.mybutton) for the className.
Must return a button element with the text 'Click Me'.

data.title: React JSX Conditional Statements
data.description:
1. Create a `StatusBadge` component that accepts an `isOnline` boolean prop (default value true).
2. Return a `<div>` element.
3. Use a ternary operator (`? :`) directly inside the JSX to conditionally change BOTH the `className` and the text inside the `<div>`.
4. If `isOnline` is true, the class must be `badge-online` and the text must be 'Online'.
5. If `isOnline` is false, the class must be `badge-offline` and the text must be 'Offline'.
6. You must NOT use normal if/else statements.

UI Requirements (Pixel-perfect): Screen Background #f0f2f5 (badge centered). Both badge classes share: text color #ffffff, padding 8px 16px, font size 14px, border-radius 20px, font-family sans-serif. badge-online background #4CAF50. badge-offline background #9E9E9E.

code_test.css: body { margin: 0; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; height: 100vh; background-color: #f0f2f5; font-family: sans-serif; } .badge-online { background-color: #4CAF50; color: #ffffff; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 14px; border-radius: 20px; } .badge-offline { background-color: #9E9E9E; color: #ffffff; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 14px; border-radius: 20px; }

requirements.description: Create a React component named `StatusBadge`.
Add a boolean prop called `isOnline` to your component.
Use a ternary operator (`? :`) to change the `className` based on the `isOnline` status.
Use a ternary operator (`? :`) to display the text 'Online' or 'Offline'.

data.title: Stateful Counter Component
data.description: Create a `Counter` component using the `useState` hook to initialize a `count` state with a default value of 0. Display the `count` inside an `<h1>` element and create a `<button>` with the text 'Increment'. When this button is clicked, the `count` value should increase by 1. UI requirements for Pixel-perfect: The main screen background should be `#edf2f7`. The counter container must have a background color of `#ffffff`, padding of `40px 60px`, `border-radius` of `16px`, and a `box-shadow` of `0 10px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)`. The `<h1>` text must be `#2d3748` with a font size of `56px` and margin-bottom of `24px`. The button must have a `#3182ce` background, `#ffffff` text, padding of `12px 24px`, `border-radius` of `8px`, font size of `18px`, `cursor: pointer` and no border (`border: none`). Use `'Segoe UI', sans-serif` for the global font family.

code_test.css: body { margin: 0; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; height: 100vh; background-color: #edf2f7; font-family: 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .counter-container { background-color: #ffffff; padding: 40px 60px; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); text-align: center; } h1 { color: #2d3748; font-size: 56px; margin: 0 0 24px 0; } button { background-color: #3182ce; color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; font-size: 18px; cursor: pointer; }

requirements.description: Component name must be 'Counter'.
Must use useState hook.
Must display the count in an h1 element.
Must have a button to increment the count.
